roles_description_length.name: roles_description_length
roles_description_length.value: "roles"."description" is null or char_length("roles"."description") between 1 and 500

audit_events_comment.name: audit_events_comment
audit_events_comment.value: "audit_events"."comment" is null or char_length("audit_events"."comment") between 1 and 10000

change_sets_description.name: change_sets_description
change_sets_description.value: "change_sets"."description" is null or char_length("change_sets"."description") between 1 and 10000

change_sets_base_ref.name: change_sets_base_ref
change_sets_base_ref.value: char_length("change_sets"."base_ref") between 1 and 256 and "change_sets"."base_ref" not like 'change-sets/%'

locks_subject.name: locks_subject
locks_subject.value: ("locks"."subject_type" = 'module' and "locks"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})*/[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$') or ("locks"."subject_type" = 'manual' and "locks"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$') or ("locks"."subject_type" = 'config' and "locks"."subject_id" = 'ccms.yaml') or ("locks"."subject_type" = 'term' and "locks"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')

working_copies_subject.name: working_copies_subject
working_copies_subject.value: ("working_copies"."subject_type" = 'module' and "working_copies"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})*/[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$') or ("working_copies"."subject_type" = 'manual' and "working_copies"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$') or ("working_copies"."subject_type" = 'config' and "working_copies"."subject_id" = 'ccms.yaml') or ("working_copies"."subject_type" = 'term' and "working_copies"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')

asset_uploads_file_name.name: asset_uploads_file_name
asset_uploads_file_name.value: "asset_uploads"."file_name" is null or char_length("asset_uploads"."file_name") between 1 and 255

comments_resolution.name: comments_resolution
comments_resolution.value: ("comments"."resolved_at" is null and "comments"."resolved_by_kind" is null and "comments"."resolved_by_id" is null) or ("comments"."resolved_at" is not null and "comments"."resolved_by_kind" is not null and "comments"."resolved_by_id" is not null and "comments"."resolved_by_kind" in ('user', 'service') and char_length("comments"."resolved_by_id") between 1 and 200 and "comments"."thread_id" = "comments"."id")
